changelog.zh-CN:
CairnLauncher 0.1.0 (Open Beta 公测版)：
- 极致性能：纯 Rust 与软渲染，冷启动约 100ms，待机内存约 15MB
- 单文件免安装，纯便携设计，数据全聚合于 .cairn 目录
- 完整支持微软官方登录、外置登录与离线模式
- 内置轻量版本更新检查、更新提示弹窗与原生就地热替换机制

> 注意：当前为 Open Beta 首发测试版本，可能存在潜在未知问题，欢迎前往 GitHub Issues 反馈交流！
changelog.en-US:
CairnLauncher 0.1.0 (Open Beta):
- Extreme performance: Pure Rust & software rendering, ~100ms cold start, ~15MB RAM
- Single-file portable design, all runtime data encapsulated within .cairn
- Full support for Microsoft OAuth, external auth, and offline profiles
- Built-in lightweight update checking, update modal prompt, and native in-place hot-swap

> Note: This is an Open Beta release and may contain unexpected bugs. Feedback on GitHub Issues is warmly welcomed!
